1879427834.name: Necklace of the Ordinary
1879427834.desc: This broken necklace once housed a fearsome spirit that dominated Umín and turned him against his friends in the caverns under the Forsaken Inn. It was taken into Mordor, but has returned and been cleansed of the evil that corrupted it. Elrond has imbued it with the Light of Eärendil, and believes it will help you banish the shadows of Mordor.

1879430394.name: Brawler's Silk-steel Helm of Exhilarating Change
1879430394.desc: Long have the people of Middle-earth rued the power of the Enemy to twist that which is good to its own dark ends - but now and again the truest craftsmen among the Free People find a way to redeem some of the darkest works and materials of the Enemy, and bind them to true and good purpose again. So it is with the mythical Silk-steel armours, woven from strands of silk taken from the dark brood of Shelob and her ilk, wound with threads of mithril and forged into the steel itself to craft armour of surpassing strength and lightness. Would that all such workings of the enemy could come to such elegant ends.

1879430906.name: Pugilist's Gloves
1879430906.desc: This armour was forged for those who are brave and foolhardy in equal measure.
